name: [EVENT] Indo Hangout
desc:
Looking for a place to hang out, chat, and have fun together? Join Indo Hangout! Meet new friends through voice chat, fish, mine crystals, collect exclusive items, and participate in various exciting events with the community!

Every donation through the map and Gamepass purchases helps support the development of Indo Hangout so that we can continue to deliver new features, improve the quality of gameplay, and create a more exciting gaming experience for all players. Every bit of your support means a lot to us!

All gameplay, features, Gamepass prices, item prices, rewards, and other content may change at any time as needed for development and game balance adjustments, without prior notice.

Let's hang out and create fun moments together!
